references.text: Basic regulations for the grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil, which accompanied the burnt offering. Here the amounts for different animals are specified.
Parallel text regarding the grain offering on the New Moon day, with the same amounts: three-tenths of an ephah for each bull and two-tenths for a ram.
The same regulations concerning the grain offering at the Feast of Unleavened Bread, with identical amounts of fine flour mixed with oil for bulls and rams.
The grain offering at the Feast of Trumpets follows the same pattern: three-tenths for the bull and two-tenths for the ram.
The grain offering on the Day of Atonement with the same amounts of fine flour mixed with oil.
Basic instructions about the grain offering (mincha) of fine flour with oil, which forms the basis for all grain offering regulations.
The grain offering at the Feast of Firstfruits, with fine flour mixed with oil as a burnt offering to the Lord.
Ezekiel's prophetic vision concerning future grain offerings with similar regulations regarding flour and oil for bulls and rams.
